subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should the public agent/session usage contract expose only the shared provider-billed total, or also persist and expose OpenRouter-specific `upstream_inference_cost` details?
rationale: Current main has a portable authoritative billed-total contract, but provider-specific details introduce new persistence, portability, privacy, and API-shape semantics that source inspection cannot determine.

options.title: Expose shared total first
options.body: Carry the existing provider-billed total and provenance through agent metadata and session usage without adding OpenRouter-specific detail fields.

options.title: Add typed provider details
options.body: Define optional provider-detail metadata with explicit units and persistence rules, including OpenRouter upstream inference cost.

options.title: Keep details provider-owned
options.body: Expose the shared total in core and leave richer OpenRouter accounting to a provider/plugin-owned runtime API.

recommendation.title: Expose shared total first
recommendation.body: Carry the existing provider-billed total and provenance through agent metadata and session usage without adding OpenRouter-specific detail fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The newest implementation history ties this person most directly to the billed-cost type, parsing, transcript accounting, and runtime normalization boundary that remains incomplete.
